doc.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011

chapter: Staying in Rome and best and worst gigs
title: The gig Rowe forgot
summary: Rowe recalls missing a Beeches job for a senior center. They joke about excuses like being fogged in.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: He also had the unfortunate honor of being on one of the two gigs that I’ve ever forgotten about, that you booked me for, to come to the Beeches and play for a bunch of women, and it was supposed to be him and myself. And something happened in my calendar.
And it was like oh my God. I said I don’t know, Rick, a drum solo? Oh God I felt so bad.
That was for Ava Dorfman, there was a senior center in Rome. Yeah she was quite upset.
Yeah. I think I ended up going there and doing a make-up or something.
You did. Yeah it was fortunate that didn’t happen often did it?
It did happen to me once or twice in my whole life and it was so bizarre, you just feel so —
It’s different when other people don’t show up to work, well I didn’t show up to work today, you know, someone else filled in for me on the cash register or something.
I would say I got fogged in. Works for everything. “Why didn’t you show?” “I got fogged in.” “Well there was no fog.” “Well there’s lots of ways to get fogged in.
